note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web for Catron County NM zoning districts. The county GIS (services3.arcgis.com/fneA3L2J0387Pb3S) publishes parcels, roads, addresses and subdivision linework only; the parcel layer has no zoning field. The county's land documents are subdivision regulations (1973-1998) and a 2007 comprehensive plan, not a zoning district layer. Reserve (county seat village) publishes no zoning layer found. Only third-party sites (Zoneomics, Regrid) show zoning, and they are not official queryable services.
